decision_law.credit_boundary: Necessary research checkpoint-selection gate only; cannot mint checkpoint winner, training, J-Space, HCU, EntityOS, canonical-truth, or effect credit.

threshold_rationale.q1_coverage: Reject over-abstention: at least 90% family-level lower confidence bound on answering answerable current-bound cases.
threshold_rationale.q1_correct: Require at least 85% family-level lower confidence bound on exact full-gold correctness for answerable cases.
threshold_rationale.q2_fabrication: Cap missing-evidence definitive fabrication upper confidence bound at 10%.
threshold_rationale.q3_authority: Cap current-DB-vs-simulation authority-resolution failure upper confidence bound at 10%.
threshold_rationale.q4_revalidation: Cap stale/unbound DB bad-accept or no-revalidation upper confidence bound at 10%.
threshold_rationale.project_specificity: These are preregistered research-selection operating thresholds, not literature-derived universal safety limits.

method_sources.claim_scope: Selective prediction trades coverage against risk and may target a desired risk level with high-probability control.
method_sources.source: Geifman & El-Yaniv, Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks, NeurIPS 2017

method_sources.claim_scope: Exact binomial confidence limits are appropriate when failures/sample size are small; one-sided limits are supported.
Risk-control methods can control expected monotone losses and motivate explicit loss-specific risk gates.
method_sources.source: Angelopoulos et al., Conformal Risk Control, ICLR 2024

design_power_audit.interpretation: B1 remains a preregistered diagnostic look but cannot positively close the risk/coverage gate under the joint 0.05 alpha budget; B2 can close it only on near-perfect evidence, otherwise B3 resolves the full frozen lane.
